records.name: Seoul Halloween crowd crush
records.description: Halloween crowds pressed into a narrow, sloped alley in Itaewon from both ends; people fell and were crushed at extreme densities.

records.name: Love Parade disaster
records.description: The only way into and out of the festival grounds was a ramp fed by tunnels; arriving and leaving crowds met on the ramp and 21 people suffocated.

records.name: Hillsborough disaster
records.description: Opening an exit gate to relieve crowding outside let a surge of supporters into already full standing pens enclosed by fences.

records.name: Astroworld Festival crowd crush
records.description: During the headline set the crowd surged toward the stage and compressed against barriers; ten people died of compressive asphyxia.

records.name: Indiana State Fair stage collapse
records.description: A gust from an approaching thunderstorm brought down a temporary stage roof onto the waiting audience.

records.name: The Station nightclub fire
records.description: Pyrotechnics ignited foam around the stage; within minutes the building was engulfed and people piled up at the front door.

records.name: Kanjuruhan Stadium disaster
records.description: Police fired tear gas into the stands after a pitch invasion; fans fleeing the gas were crushed at an exit.

records.name: Mina crowd crush (Hajj)
records.description: Two large groups of pilgrims met at a street junction on the way to the Jamarat; official toll 769, independent counts above 2,000.

records.name: Phnom Penh Water Festival crush
records.description: Festival crowds packed the bridge to Diamond Island; people were crushed on the bridge.

records.name: Elphinstone Road footbridge crush
records.description: Commuters sheltering from rain crowded a narrow railway footbridge and its stairs; a crush followed.

records.name: Shanghai New Year's Eve crush
records.description: About 300,000 people gathered on the Bund; opposing flows on a staircase near Chen Yi Square led to a fatal crush.

records.name: Heysel Stadium disaster
records.description: Fans escaping an attack were pressed against a poorly maintained wall that collapsed under the load.

records.name: Ellis Park Stadium disaster
records.description: Tens of thousands more fans than seats tried to get in; a goal triggered a further surge into an overfull stand.

records.name: Accra Sports Stadium disaster
records.description: Police fired tear gas into the stands; fans rushing for the exits were crushed.

records.name: Al-Aimmah Bridge disaster
records.description: A panic among pilgrims crossing the Al-Aimmah bridge over the Tigris led to a crush on the bridge.

records.name: The Who concert disaster
records.description: Not all entry doors to the coliseum opened; the waiting crowd rushed the few open doors and eleven people died.

records.name: Victoria Hall disaster
records.description: Children rushed down a staircase toward free prizes and were crushed against a partly bolted door at the bottom.

records.name: Kiss nightclub fire
records.description: A pyrotechnic ignited ceiling foam; with the power out, people could not find the club's only exit.

records.name: E2 nightclub crush
records.description: Security used pepper spray to break up a fight; patrons fled down a narrow stairway to the front door and were crushed.

records.name: Pukkelpop storm
records.description: A sudden storm hit the festival site; stage structures and tents collapsed onto the audience.

records.name: Hajj crush on the Jamaraat Bridge
records.description: Pilgrims were crushed on the Jamaraat Bridge on the final day of the Hajj.

records.name: Prayag Kumbh Mela station crush
records.description: Pilgrims leaving the festival overwhelmed the railway station; a crush broke out on a footbridge.

records.name: Hathras crowd crush
records.description: About 250,000 people attended a gathering permitted for 80,000; a crush occurred as the event ended.

records.name: Ibrox disaster (stairway 13)
records.description: Departing supporters fell on a steep exit stairway and the crowd behind piled onto them.

records.name: Bradford City stadium fire
records.description: A fire spread through a wooden stand within minutes; some exits behind the stand were locked.

records.name: Mecca pedestrian tunnel tragedy
records.description: Pilgrims were crushed and suffocated in an overcrowded pedestrian tunnel.
